vital_records.summary: Certified copies come from the vital records office in the state where the death happened. The CDC keeps a directory with a link to every state office.

death_investigation.summary: State law decides which deaths a medical examiner or coroner reviews and how the office works.

probate.summary: I do not have verified probate steps for this state yet. The state's court website and an estate attorney are the best next sources.

intestacy.summary: I do not have verified guidance for this state yet. An estate attorney can confirm who inherits.

attorney_flag.reason: Heirship is set by state law.

vehicle_transfer.summary: I do not have verified vehicle steps for this state yet. The state motor vehicle agency's website lists the forms it accepts.

dmv_notification.summary: I do not have verified steps for this state yet. The state motor vehicle agency's website explains how to report a deceased driver.

cremation_authorization.summary: Your cremation provider will explain who must sign under this state's law.

real_estate_transfer.summary: Real estate transfer depends on state law and the deed. Talk with an attorney.

attorney_flag.reason: Real property transfer is a legal process.

grief_support.summary: If you ever feel unsafe or in crisis, you can call or text 988, or chat at 988lifeline.org, any time.
